newsitem.title: USA: MidCap Value Fund sets annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: MidCap Value Fund sets annual dividend.

text.p: MidCap Value Fund class A, class B and class M shares set an annual dividend on Friday consisting of short-term and long-term capital gains.

Dividends for class A, B and M shares comprised of $0.1096 from short-term capital gains and $0.0047 from long-term capital gains, payable on January 22 1997 to shareholders of record on December 31 1996.
The previous dividend for class A, B and M shares, which amounted to $0.0667, $0.0484 and $0.0626 respectively, were payable on August 20 1996.
A company spokesman said dividends are paid on "somewhat" of an annual basis.
